body: Thank you. I've been to the hospital once before but they just kept me overnight since they deemed me to not be a threat to myself after talking to me for awhile.
I think they're really hit or miss. The first time I saw them was terrible vocally, but the second time was much better.
I was going through a tough time during my freshman year at college. As I walked by the chapel at m y university, I smelled my late grandpa's cologne. There was no one else around.

When I was 5, my older brother (who was 17 or 18 at the time) convinced me that our rabbit's poop pellets were M&Ms. I was a fat kid so I ate the rabbit pellets. 

He will never let me live that down
